description: This file declares the RequestHandler class, which appears to be a singleton responsible for managing lifecycle-related requests within the WPEFramework Plugin namespace. It provides methods for initializing, terminating, launching applications, terminating them, sending intents, and updating states, as well as accessors for component handlers like RuntimeManagerHandler, WindowManagerHandler, and an event handler. The class interacts with multiple component headers included at the top.

classes.name: RequestHandler
classes.description: A singleton class that manages lifecycle and application requests within the WPEFramework Plugin environment. It provides methods to initialize, terminate, launch applications, send intents, update states, and access specific component handlers like RuntimeManagerHandler, WindowManagerHandler, and IEventHandler. It holds private members for these handlers and enforces singleton pattern by deleting copy constructor and providing a static getInstance method.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of RequestHandler.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Sets up the RequestHandler with the provided service context and event handler.

methods.name: terminate
methods.description: Cleans up resources used by the RequestHandler.

methods.name: launch
methods.description: Launches an application within a given context and target lifecycle state. Returns success status and error reason if any.

methods.name: terminate
methods.description: Terminates an application within a given context. Returns success status and error reason if any.

methods.name: sendIntent
methods.description: Sends an intent within a given application context. Returns success status and error reason if any.

methods.name: updateState
methods.description: Updates the lifecycle state of an application within a context. Returns success status and error reason if any.

methods.name: getRuntimeManagerHandler
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the RuntimeManagerHandler component.

methods.name: getWindowManagerHandler
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the WindowManagerHandler component.

methods.name: getEventHandler
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the IEventHandler component.
